text:
nina_support: Hi team — customer alex_corp is seeing intermittent 429s during a demo ingest and then 401s when they attempted a key rotation. They say this started after they hit their free-tier limits. Log snippet from them:

alex_corp: posting log excerpt:
```
> curl -i https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_abc123'
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-request-id: rwd-req-98765
Retry-After: 30
{"error":{"type":"rate_limit_error","code":"quota_exceeded","limit":60,"period":60}}
```

alex_corp: then when we rotated the key via the console we got 401s for ~5 minutes: `401 invalid_api_key` then it cleared. We're blocked for our onboarding demo tomorrow. Any temporary option?

josh_oncall: Thanks — sounds like two related things: hitting request-rate quota (429/quota_exceeded) and a short invalidation window after key rotation (401). Can you provide the org id and the failing request_ids (e.g., rwd-req-98765) so I can correlate logs? Also did the 401s show `x-request-id`?

alex_corp: org_id=org_7701, request_ids: rwd-req-98765, rwd-req-98786. 401s had `x-request-id: rwd-req-98800`. We rotated via UI ~2024-07-02T16:12:00Z.

nina_support: Repro notes for internal triage:
- Free-tier default burst: 60 requests/minute and 5 concurrent connections for text generate endpoint.
- Behavior observed: sustained traffic at ~90rpm triggered 429s. Console key rotation triggers short cache invalidation; some in-flight requests may return 401 until caches propagate (~a few minutes).

nina_support: Quick mitigation steps for customer:
1) Immediately reduce concurrent workers to <=5 and implement exponential backoff with jitter. Example header handling: if response includes `Retry-After`, respect it.
2) If you need a temporary uplift for the demo, we can whitelist org_7701 for a 48h soft uplift (increases rate to 600rpm for hosted API). That requires sign-off from sales and a short terms acknowledgement.
3) To avoid 401 during rotation: create a new key (`POST /v1/keys`) and switch traffic to the new key; then revoke the old key after confirmations. Avoid rotating a key while running a high-concurrency ingest.

alex_corp: Can you do the whitelist? Demo is tomorrow at 10am PST. We can accept a short terms email.

sara_sales: I can approve a 48h soft uplift pending customer confirmation and a written acknowledgement that they'll move to paid tier within 30 days or we'll revert. I'll need billing contact and PO preference. nina_support — please create a temporary ticket and mark as "sales-assisted uplift requested".

nina_support: Done — support ticket #SUP-123456 created. I've added the customer's billing email (billing@alexcorp.com) and requested org_id verification. I'll add a link to the billing status: billing-bot: account show org_7701 -> returns `status: past_due` and `invoices_unpaid: 1` (invoice #INV-904).

billing-bot: Automated message: org_7701 billing status -> past_due. Outstanding invoice INV-904 total $450. Payment link: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoice/INV-904

alex_corp: That's a surprise — invoice should've auto-charged, looks like card expired. We'll update card now.

nina_support: Two paths:
- Fast path (preferred): Customer updates card and pays INV-904. Once payment clears, billing lock is removed and we can escalate to sales for a paid plan/committed capacity (no more 429s at low concurrency).
- Temporary demo path: If customer cannot clear payment now, we can still apply a 48h soft uplift to org_7701 as a goodwill, but we need explicit written acknowledgement and a card-on-file promise. Sara will coordinate.

josh_oncall: From an engineering perspective, I'll pull the proxy logs for those request_ids and double-check if the 401s align with key-revocation events. If we see >5% of requests failing post-rotation we'll file a small infra bug to reduce propagation delay.

sara_sales: Alex, please confirm in this thread whether you accept the uplift terms (48h demo uplift, then either convert to paid or revert). If yes, I'll send an email template and a one-click acceptance link.

alex_corp: Confirmed — we accept the 48h uplift and will update billing ASAP. Please whitelist org_7701.

nina_support: Action items:
- nina_support: created SUP-123456, added log snippet and billing state.
- sara_sales: will send uplift terms and email; will also open a sales opportunity for a paid plan and follow up on PO.
- josh_oncall: will investigate proxy logs and post findings in SUP-123456 before EOD.

nina_support: Temporary uplift applied for org_7701 -> 48h soft uplift to 600rpm and 20 concurrent connections. Please monitor and report any residual 401s. If card payment clears, we can convert to paid immediately and remove soft limits. :thumbsup:

alex_corp: Thanks everyone — I'll update once payment processed and will follow the key rotation guidance.

josh_oncall: FYI for eng teams: recommend we add an explicit console warning during key rotation when active connections >5, and a short note on expected 2-3 minute propagation window. Filing feature suggestion under ENG-UX.

nina_support: Closing loop here — SUP-123456 remains open until payment or conversion. If anything breaks during the uplift we will escalate to incident channel.

sara_sales: I'll take it from here for the commercial follow-up.

alex_corp: Appreciate the quick turnaround.
